diagnosis: Mucinous carcinoma of vagina, intestinal type
legend: A polypoid vaginal mass composed of intestinal-type epithelium, ranging from adenoma to carcinoma. In the center of the right tissue section, the tumour can be seen extending into or arising from a Bartholin duct.
